description: Start here. Headline count of everything in a directory that is addressed to an AI agent rather than to you: instruction files, hook commands wired to run automatically, MCP servers the repo declares, and skills/commands/subagents it ships. Use before working in a repo you did not write, or when reviewing a PR that touches agent config.
